reference.question: What is the area of a sector with radius 6 and central angle \(60^\circ\)? (The area can be written in the form \(k\pi\); enter only the value of \(k\).)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Sector area formula

\(S=n\pi r^2/360=60\pi\times 36/360=6\pi\), so \(k=6\).
